modules.title: Network Infrastructure Security
modules.description: Protecting network systems from social engineering attacks
objectives: Identify social engineering tactics targeting NMS teams

materials.title: Understanding NMS Vulnerabilities
materials.content: Network Management Systems are prime targets for attackers seeking infrastructure access through social engineering.

materials.title: Social Engineering Defense
materials.content: Learn to recognize sophisticated social engineering attempts targeting network teams, including vendor impersonation and emergency scenario manipulation.

quiz.question: A vendor emails requesting emergency network configuration changes. What should you do first?
options: Verify the request through established secure channels
quiz.explanation: Always verify emergency requests through established secure communication channels before implementation to prevent social engineering attacks.

quiz.question: What is the primary social engineering risk for NMS teams?
quiz.explanation: Attackers target NMS teams specifically to gain unauthorized access to network configurations and infrastructure.

modules.title: Employee Data Protection
modules.description: Safeguarding sensitive employee information and POPIA compliance

materials.title: POPIA Compliance Essentials
materials.content: Understanding the Protection of Personal Information Act requirements for employee data handling and protection.

quiz.question: Under POPIA, employee consent for data processing must be:
quiz.explanation: POPIA requires specific, informed consent for personal data processing - it cannot be implied or assumed.

modules.title: Privilege Access Management
modules.description: Managing administrative access and preventing privilege escalation

materials.title: Principle of Least Privilege
materials.content: Granting only the minimum access necessary for job functions to reduce attack surface and prevent privilege escalation.

quiz.question: The principle of least privilege means:
quiz.explanation: Users should have only the access necessary to perform their job functions, reducing potential damage from compromised accounts.
